status_note: A summary written for ELI Legal, in its own words. It is not the text of the instrument and has not been validated by a qualified lawyer. Check the official text before relying on any statement in it. Section numbers are given as a guide; confirm them against the Act as amended.
title: Data Protection Act 2018 (Ireland)
description: Ireland's act completing the GDPR. It is the example of national implementing law the use case takes; in another member state, use that state's act.

requirements.title: Criminal-offence data
requirements.text: Personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences is processed only under the conditions the Act sets.

requirements.title: Legal privilege
requirements.text: Data-subject rights do not extend to material protected by legal privilege. Privileged material is filed with the privileged scope and stays within those entitled to it.

requirements.reference: provisions on courts acting in a judicial capacity
requirements.title: Supervision of the courts
requirements.text: Processing by the courts acting in their judicial capacity is supervised separately from the Data Protection Commission.
